covers: Friday 6 November closes on the JSE and Wall Street, the week to 6 November, and weekend moves in the rand, gold, platinum, oil and copper to early Monday. This edition is built from closing prices only; weekend news stories could not be checked in time and are left out until they are verified.
headline: JSE ended last week up 4.8% while the S&P 500 fell 2.7%; gold starts Monday near $4,126 and the rand near R16.49/$
summary: In South Africa the JSE All Share closed Friday at 112,739 (+4.8% on the week) and the Top 40 at 104,714 (+5.3%), and the rand closed the week at R16.48/$, about 0.8% firmer (Yahoo Finance closes, 6 Nov). On Wall Street the S&P 500 closed Friday at 7,376.86, up 0.3% on the day but down 2.7% on the week, and the Nasdaq at 24,579.42, down 3.4% on the week, while the US 10-year yield eased to 4.86% (Yahoo Finance, 6 Nov). Gold was $4,125.70 early Monday (+1.2% on Friday's close) and Brent $98.22 after falling about 16% last week, which keeps support under JSE miners as US October inflation (Tuesday) and SA jobs data (Tuesday) come into focus.

items.title: S&P 500 closes Friday at 7,376.86 (+0.3%), down 2.7% on the week; Nasdaq 24,579.42, down 3.4%
items.summary: Friday's S&P 500 close compares with 7,353.73 on Thursday and 7,580.07 on 30 October. The Nasdaq Composite closed at 24,579.42 against 25,437.00 a week earlier, after Thursday's tech sell-off and Friday's partial rebound following the October jobs report. The US 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.86%, down from 4.93% a week earlier. The Fed funds target range is 3.75%–4.00%.
items.source: Yahoo Finance daily closes (^GSPC, ^IXIC, ^TNX), 6 Nov 2026, via LRC Market Dashboard

items.title: US October CPI due Tuesday 10 November at 15:30 SAST
items.summary: September CPI inflation was 3.7% year on year (BLS, 14 Oct 2026). The BLS schedule lists the October report for Tuesday 10 November at 08:30 New York time.
items.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics release schedule, checked 7 Nov 2026

items.title: JSE All Share closes the week at 112,739 (+4.8%), Top 40 at 104,714 (+5.3%)
items.summary: The All Share closed Friday 6 November at 112,739.38 against 107,621.70 on 30 October, and the Top 40 at 104,713.98 against 99,412.30, while gold rose 4.5% and platinum 7.0% over the same week. The SA 10-year bond yield was near 8.60% on 4 November, the lowest since mid-August (Trading Economics, 4 Nov).
items.source: Yahoo Finance daily closes (^J203.JO, ^J200.JO), 6 Nov 2026, via LRC Market Dashboard; Trading Economics, 4 Nov 2026

items.title: Data week: Q3 jobs survey on Tuesday, CPI on 18 November, SARB decision on 19 November
items.summary: Stats SA's Quarterly Labour Force Survey for Q3 is due Tuesday 10 November; Q2 unemployment was 33.6% (up from 32.7%). October CPI follows on 18 November (September: 4.5%) and the Reserve Bank's MPC decision is scheduled for 19 November, with the repo rate at 7.25% since the 23 September hike.
items.source: Stats SA via SAnews (Q2 QLFS, 11 Aug 2026; CPI, 21 Oct 2026); BusinessTech, 23 Sep 2026; LRC Macro Desk calendar

items.title: Rand R16.49/$ early Monday after closing the week 0.8% firmer at R16.48
items.summary: USD/ZAR closed Friday at 16.4804 against 16.6066 on 30 October and was 16.4928 early on 9 November. The rand was R18.38 per euro and R22.04 per pound early Monday.
items.source: Yahoo Finance (ZAR=X, EURZAR=X, GBPZAR=X), 6 and 9 Nov 2026, via LRC Market Dashboard

items.title: Gold $4,125.70 (+1.2% since Friday), platinum $1,552.20, Brent $98.22, copper about $13,974/t
items.summary: Gold futures closed last week at $4,074.90, up 4.5% on the week, and were $4,125.70 in the latest session (8 Nov). Platinum rose to $1,552.20 from $1,538.20 on Friday. Brent was $98.22 after closing Friday at $98.32, down from $117.64 a week earlier (−16.4%). Copper was about $13,974 a tonne (+1.6% on Friday's $13,751).
items.source: Yahoo Finance futures (GC=F, PL=F, BZ=F, HG=F), 6 and 8 Nov 2026, via LRC Market Dashboard
